title: Independent Research in Agricultural Economics
prerequisites: Consent of instructor or director of undergraduate studies and completion of a proposed plan of learning objectives and outcomes prior to registration. The student must have completed 60 credit hours prior to registering for AEC 395 and the student must earn a C or better in one of the following courses: AEC 303, AEC 302, or AEC 305
repeatability: Repeatable to a maximum of 6Directed independent study of a selected problem.
